title: Sideload update
noDevice: Connect a device to install an OTA update with adb sideload.

warning.title: Don't unplug the cable or let the battery die.
warning.body: Interrupting a sideload can leave the phone unbootable.
warning.batteryLow: Battery is at {{level}}% — charge it first.
warning.batteryUnknown: Check that the battery is charged: it can't be read in sideload mode.

file.drop: Drop the OTA zip here or pick it
file.hint: A full or incremental OTA package for this device (.zip)

checks.label: Safety checks
checks.stateOk: The device is waiting in Apply update from ADB
checks.stateWrong: The device is not in sideload mode yet (now: {{state}})
checks.batteryMeh: Battery {{level}}% — charging to 30% or more is safer
checks.batteryLow: Battery {{level}}% — below {{min}}%, recovery would refuse the update
checks.batteryUnknown: Battery level unknown: it was not read before the device entered recovery
checks.batteryAck: I checked that the battery is at least {{min}}% charged
checks.notOta: This zip is not an OTA package
checks.targetWrong: Made for {{devices}}, but this device is {{device}}
checks.targetUnknown: The package doesn't say which device it is for
checks.targetUnverified: Made for {{devices}}; this device's codename is unknown
checks.signed: Signature block present — recovery verifies it
checks.unsigned: No signature block: stock recovery will reject it
checks.wipe: Erases all data on the device

progress.doneHint: Recovery finishes installing on its own. Follow the phone's screen, then choose Reboot system now.

cancel.title: Stop the sideload?
cancel.body: If recovery has started writing the update, stopping now can leave the phone unbootable until you sideload again.

confirm.title: Install the update on {{name}}?
confirm.body: {{file}} will be sent to recovery and installed. Keep the cable connected until the phone says it's done.
confirm.wipe: This package erases all data on the device.

howto.title: How to start a sideload
howto.step1: Reboot to recovery from the device menu
howto.step2: On the phone choose Apply update from ADB
howto.step3: Drop the OTA zip here or pick it
howto.confirmBody: The phone restarts into recovery and waits for an update over adb. Apps and the screen are unavailable until you reboot it again.
